# Computational Linear Algebra — Calculate With Matrices

Book Chapter 3 covers row reduction, matrix equations, multiplication, determinants and inverses. Each operation answers a precise question.

## Follow the chapters

1. [gaussian elimination](01-gaussian-elimination.qmd)
2. [determinant and inverse](02-determinant-and-inverse.qmd)
3. [matrix multiplication](03-matrix-multiplication.qmd)

Start from the first one. Read the mathematical statement aloud, name every symbol, put numbers into it, and explain **why** it works.

**Textbook structure:** Ivan Savov, *No Bullshit Guide to Linear Algebra*, second edition, Computational Linear Algebra — Calculate With Matrices. The PDF supplied was a **preview**; these are original teaching chapters built around its topic map.
